Hi Priya,

Quick note from Payments LLC — we completed a banking consolidation over the weekend and need Redwood to update our vendor record so ACH/wires route to the new branch. New details are in the bank change form attached.

What we need from you:
- Update bank routing and account on file for Payments LLC (tax Id 12-3456789)
- Update remittance address on POs to: Payments LLC, AP Dept, 410 Harbor Lane, Suite 200, Portland, OR 97201
- Confirm whether you need a reissued PO for any open orders or if AP will automatically reroute payments to the new account.

I've attached a signed vendor bank change form and a voided check to validate the account. If you need additional verification (certified bank letter), let me know and I can request one.

Also please update our portal owner to samir.gupta@payments-llc.com — the previous contact is no longer at the company.

Thanks,
Samir Gupta

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and for sending the attachments.

A few quick items so we can make the change without delay:
1) I need the signed vendor bank change form (received) and either a voided check (received) or a bank letter on company letterhead. The files you sent look good — we'll run internal verification.
2) Please confirm whether Payments LLC wants us to reroute payments for existing open POs automatically, or if you'd like us to hold rerouting until you confirm. If automatic reroute is okay, note that it will apply to invoices submitted after the change; we don't retroactively change issued payments.
3) Confirm the exact email to set as portal owner (you mentioned samir.gupta@payments-llc.com). If there are any secondary contacts for escalations, list them.

I'll loop in Ben (AP) and Rishi (Finance) to validate the account and schedule a test ACH (small-dollar) to confirm settlement. Ben — can you take this from here if verification passes? Rishi — FYI in case any approvals from Treasury are required.

I'll update you as soon as AP confirms.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
